finding.expected: REPAIR_AUTHORING must accept the bounded canonical FAILURE structure used by Runtime and project only the minimum safe failure observations needed by Brain (for example bounded type/message and other explicitly allowed diagnostic facts), excluding raw logs and machine-local material. Add a regression test using a Runtime-shaped FAILURE with structured error data and prove malformed or over-bound failure observations still fail closed.
finding.issue: REPAIR_AUTHORING does not accept the canonical FAILURE shape already produced by Runtime. The implementation projects failure phase/reason/error and then applies _bounded_text to every observation value; canonical FAILURE.error is a structured mapping (for example {"type": "...", "message": "...", "verification": [...]}) rather than a string. A legitimate failed RUN therefore raises DecisionPacketError before a REPAIR_AUTHORING packet can be emitted, so one of the six required BP-3 flows is not representable for an existing canonical lifecycle state. The focused test uses a reduced FAILURE fixture that omits this structured error and misses the state-space counterexample.

original_constraints: AIOS_DECISION_PACKET v1 remains one deterministic, read-only, provider-neutral envelope for exactly one selected semantic decision and supports exactly the existing six BP-3 flows: ARCHITECTURE, TASK_AUTHORING, SEMANTIC_REVIEW, REMEDIATION_AUTHORING, REPAIR_AUTHORING and DIAGNOSTIC. NONE, unknown flows, unknown payload kinds and packet nesting fail closed.

Preserve Decision Packet v1 boundedness and portability: rendered packet at most 131072 UTF-8 bytes; Human input at most 16384 bytes; any included free-text excerpt/delta field at most 65536 bytes; invalid Unicode, NaN/non-JSON values and over-bound input/output fail closed without truncation. Exclude machine-local root/workspace/remote details, raw evidence paths/logs, secrets, chat history, chain-of-thought, timestamps and provider/session metadata.

Do not modify files outside scope.modify. If satisfying this contract requires changing Unified State, Correction Frontier, Flow Resolver, transport/publication contracts, correction dispatch/approval authority, provider surfaces or frozen Kernel semantics, fail closed back to Brain rather than widening scope.
